title: 's-Gravenambacht
text:
's-Gravenambacht
's-Gravenambacht
'
s-Gravenambacht
is a former
hamlet
and former
municipality
in the
Dutch
province of
South Holland
. The area is now part of
Rotterdam
, and almost completely covered by the Eemhaven
dockyards
. The western part of the village of
Heijplaat
is also in this area.
The municipality existed between 1817 and 1832, when it merged with
Pernis
.
